en.decision: Rank a fixed-capacity human review queue; do not contact customers or make a retention decision.
en.dataAndModel: Uses a synthetic snapshot with a point-in-time rule and compares a candidate ranking with a rule baseline. There is no LLM layer in this case.
en.doesNotProve: It does not establish generalisation to real customers, improved retention, or a replacement for human review.

en.title: Run it yourself: KEV Review Packet starter
en.text: This downloadable exercise uses an invented vulnerability record shaped like public fields. It only builds a packet for human review; incomplete source fields, private data, or a request for a real security action are rejected. It includes a blank `NOT_ACQUIRED` static-source receipt template for a copy you later retain yourself; it does not turn the fixture into public data.
en.boundary: Extract it before running the commands. It has no API key, network, or model call and cannot scan, patch, create a ticket, or inspect a system; it only shows that fixed fictional cases can be repeated, not a real vulnerability, affected asset, or security approval.

zh-HK.decision: 由一份按來源欄位設計嘅 KEV record fixture，決定交出 evidence packet 定拒絕 source；之後由 security reviewer 判斷，唔會 scan、patch 或開 ticket。
zh-HK.dataAndModel: 只用 fixture record、source manifest 同固定 cases。Promptfoo 同 gpt-5-mini Responses file 只係預留做教學示範嘅設定檔，冇執行 live evaluation。
zh-HK.doesNotProve: 唔證明任何組織受影響、漏洞狀態、remediation decision、live model result 或 security approval。

zh-TW.decision: 從一份依來源欄位設計的 KEV record fixture，決定交出 evidence packet 或拒絕 source；後續由 security reviewer 判斷，不會 scan、patch 或開 ticket。
zh-TW.dataAndModel: 只使用 fixture record、source manifest 與固定 cases。Promptfoo 與 gpt-5-mini Responses file 只是保留作教學示範的設定檔，沒有執行 live evaluation。

zh-Hans.decision: 从一份按来源栏位设计的 KEV record fixture，决定交出 evidence packet 或拒绝 source；后续由 security reviewer 判断，不会 scan、patch 或开 ticket。
zh-Hans.dataAndModel: 只使用 fixture record、source manifest 与固定 cases。Promptfoo 与 gpt-5-mini Responses file 只是保留作教学示范的设定档，没有执行 live evaluation。
zh-Hans.doesNotProve: 不证明任何组织受影响、漏洞状态、remediation decision、live model result 或 security approval。

en.decision: Choose whether a KEV record fixture with source fields becomes an evidence packet or is rejected; a security reviewer decides what follows, with no scanning, patching, or ticket creation.

en.doesNotProve: It does not establish organisational exposure, vulnerability status, a remediation decision, a live-model result, or security approval.

en.text: This downloadable exercise uses invented monthly numbers only. It checks whether a source receipt is complete enough for a person to write background context; it does not forecast a job market or make a hiring or pay decision.
en.boundary: Extract it before running the commands. It has no API key, network, or model call and fetches no public numbers; it only shows that fixed fictional cases can be repeated, not a current statistic, forecasting ability, business value, or publication approval.

zh-HK.decision: 判斷一份按來源欄位設計嘅 monthly-series fixture，夠唔夠交畀人寫 context brief；唔作 hiring、pay、個人工作選擇、forecast 或 publication decision。
zh-HK.dataAndModel: 只用合成 monthly series、source manifest 同固定 cases。Promptfoo 同 gpt-5-mini Responses file 只係預留做教學示範嘅設定檔，冇拉取 live statistics。
zh-HK.doesNotProve: 唔證明勞動市場現況、招聘趨勢、薪酬、個人工作結果、預測、live model result 或發佈批准。

zh-TW.decision: 判斷一份依來源欄位設計的 monthly-series fixture 是否足以交給人撰寫 context brief；不做 hiring、pay、個人職涯、forecast 或 publication decision。
zh-TW.dataAndModel: 只使用合成 monthly series、source manifest 與固定 cases。Promptfoo 與 gpt-5-mini Responses file 只是保留作教學示範的設定檔，沒有擷取 live statistics。
zh-TW.doesNotProve: 不證明勞動市場現況、招聘趨勢、薪酬、個人職涯結果、預測、live model result 或發布核准。

zh-Hans.decision: 判断一份按来源栏位设计的 monthly-series fixture 是否足以交给人撰写 context brief；不做 hiring、pay、个人职业、forecast 或 publication decision。
zh-Hans.dataAndModel: 只使用合成 monthly series、source manifest 与固定 cases。Promptfoo 与 gpt-5-mini Responses file 只是保留作教学示范的设定档，没有拉取 live statistics。
zh-Hans.doesNotProve: 不证明劳动力市场现况、招聘趋势、薪酬、个人职业结果、预测、live model result 或发布批准。

en.decision: Decide whether a monthly-series fixture with source fields is sufficient for a person to write a context brief; it cannot determine hiring, pay, an individual's next career move, a forecast, or publication.
en.dataAndModel: Uses a synthetic monthly series, source manifest, and fixed cases. The Promptfoo and gpt-5-mini Responses files are optional local teaching configurations; no live statistics are fetched.
en.doesNotProve: It does not establish labour-market conditions, hiring trends, pay, individual career outcomes, a forecast, a live-model result, or publication approval.
